card.name: Scattered words in drug label text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words such as a space before a number, 'drugs', 'that', or the middle of a drug name, mostly in drug-label text.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a long drug name, such as ritonavir or sacituzumab.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Linking words or general nouns in interaction or lactation statements.
